mods.name: TerrariumVoxel
mods.title: TerrariumVoxel (a Terrarium fork)
mods.author: poooooby
mods.summary: 3D voxel diorama for Gen 1 (Red/Blue/Yellow). Gold is an early first pass — not recommended yet. Own id, folder, pipelines and letter hotkeys; installs beside DRAMATIC_SHAPE. A fork of BrenoBertucci's Terrarium (itself a fork of DramaticShape's Dramatic Shape Voxel Mod).
